text.tspan: An Ethernet frame, field by field (sizes in bytes)
(it comes first, so it can decide
early) and LEARNS from the source
What tcpdump shows: the 14-byte header + payload (never the 8-byte preamble or the FCS)
a ping: 14 + 84 = 98 bytes · a full 1500-byte IP packet: 1514 bytes
On the wire the frame is 1518 bytes (1522 with a VLAN tag), plus the preamble and a gap
